First, convert 15 weeks and 2 days to days:  
15 weeks × 7 days = 105 days  
105 days + 2 days = 107 days earlier.

Date given: 1056-12-15.  
Subtract 107 days:  
December has 31 days, so from Dec 15 back 15 days → Nov 30.  
Remaining days: 107 - 15 = 92 days earlier from Nov 30.  
November has 30 days, so back 30 days → Oct 31.  
Remaining: 92 - 30 = 62 days earlier from Oct 31.  
October has 31 days, so back 31 days → Sep 30.  
Remaining: 62 - 31 = 31 days earlier from Sep 30.  
September has 30 days, so back 30 days → Aug 31.  
Remaining: 31 - 30 = 1 day earlier from Aug 31 → Aug 30.

Year 1056 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not century exception in Gregorian? Actually Gregorian starts 1582, but here we use proleptic Gregorian rules: leap if divisible by 4, but centuries must be divisible by 400; 1056 divisible by 4, not a century year, so leap).  
But leap year doesn’t affect Aug–Dec in this subtraction.

Final date: 1056-08-30.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1056-08-30
